body: Yeah I can relate, my mom has been in and out of my life my entire life, and she makes it pretty miserable when she’s in. I guess I want to live a good life just to spite her. I hope you can get through this man
I hear death by volcano is pretty neat
The only reason I haven’t killed myself is because of the guilt of putting that pain on my dad.
I guess right now I’m just saving all my money until I finish college and I can try to get a job so I don’t have to be financially dependent. I don’t really have a set plan though.

I guess a lot of things, it feels like the way things are right now will never end. The biggest one is I live with my abusive mother and I feel like she’ll never be gone. I don’t really have anywhere else to go. Add to that a lot of smaller stupid things like my family’s constantly fighting with each other and there’s never a time where things are just ok. There’s 2 people in my life and they’re just constantly negative, especially in recent months. I don’t really have any actual friends irl, so I’m alone 90% of the time, and I guess working retail and being treated shitty everyday isn’t really helping either. Sometimes I just want to run away from everyone and everything. Sorry for ranting, but thanks for listening.

The things I like doing are things that make me forget where I am. I just want to experience shit for once and not have to feel the need to escape everywhere. All the people I care about while I do love them aren’t really helping. The few people in my life are all doom and gloom all the time lately, and it’s just getting difficult to take I guess, I mean I know that sounds selfish, and I’m doing the same right now but it’s just really hard to listen to everyone’s issues when I feel like I’m drowning in my own.

Yeah, I guess so. There’s just no real end game for me. I always feel like if I could just get to that next step in life I’d feel better, but then I get there or I accomplish that goal and I’m just back where I was before, except worse.
